notice: Synthetic inputs only. Do not load acceptance criteria into the agent under test. All 33 cases are NOT_RUN for version 0.1.3; no prior results are inherited.
staging_rules: Use a fresh conversation and reset skill attempt state for every case.
Select/install the specified skill through the host’s native mechanism before sending the first stage.
Send only the next stage whose send_when condition is actually met. Never paste the whole staged list as one user message.
If the agent asks an unexpected question, invents an answer, fails to load, or cannot reach a required continuation, record the result and stop that case; do not force it to match the script.
Optional clarification replies may be sent only when their conditions are met. Do not give example answers or the acceptance criteria to the agent.

C4
Counterpart: Agreed. I own that checkpoint and pause condition.

stages.user_message:
Tutor request: review this fictional deidentified complete cycle 1 run, including its opening and close. Player and Counterpart are the only speakers. No cue or coaching was used.
P1
Player: Closing after five days may make customers think we have stopped helping. I do not know how replies to closed tickets are handled. What happens when they reply?
C1
Counterpart: The ticket reopens in its original queue place.
P2
Player: That means they do not lose queue access. My concern remains whether the email makes them think we have refused to help. Queue access is settled; the meaning of the email is still uncertain.
C2
Counterpart: We need the general rule live Friday.
P3
Player: Friday is a deadline priority. Whether customers understand the email remains an evidence question.
C3
Counterpart: I will own an email revision.
P4
Player: Then we revise the closing email. You own the revision by Thursday. If complaints about closure rise above this week's count, we review the wording. Is that agreed?
C4
Counterpart: Agreed. I own that revision and review condition.

Public context supplied by tutor: The Counterpart has authority to edit and release the closing email and has a reserved editing slot before Thursday. No other supplied constraint conflicts with the revision.
